title: Ctrl-` then typing at once, then Cmd-D before the new tab is ready: the text reaches the new tab's shell, in order; the split's shell and the old tab get none of it
why: Lead 2026-10-29 (lagFirstKey, felt items 3-4): a held key goes to the target it was typed for when that target is ready, even after the person's next command moved the focus (Chrome: input queued for a renderer goes to that renderer). Dropping it lost text in the common fast case "ls, Cmd-D". The held key then goes straight to the new tab's terminal view, which does not have the keyboard: only the real app on a real daemon proves those bytes reach its PTY.
source: cp/fix-held-keys-followup a08c7f828c1 (held keys go to their own target), 7b8988c03a9
